summary: Implemented the provider property wizard steps for details, price and payment, and features and services using the current provider property detail and versioned step-save contracts. The implementation preserves conditional validation, provider ownership, optimistic version handling, localized RTL/LTR rendering, desktop-only scope, safe unavailable-catalog states, and loading, error, retry, permission, not-found, and success states.

verification.notes: Web TypeScript and generated contract types passed.
Web runtime, tests, and Playwright files passed ESLint with zero warnings.

Focused regression suite passed 8 tests covering exact GET/PATCH routes, auth headers, details conditional validation, payment-plan currency validation, feature/service overlap rejection, locale direction, and anonymous/forbidden access.
Full Web suite passed 27 Vitest files with 176 tests and 76 Node checks. An existing non-fatal MSW warning for an unrelated public article-category request remained.
Web client and SSR builds passed; Vite emitted only the existing chunk-size warning.
12/12 executable Playwright journeys passed while generating the nine PRV-05/PRV-06/PRV-07 desktop locale snapshots.

Final 12/12 browser journeys passed with committed snapshots matching across Arabic RTL, English LTR, and Simplified Chinese LTR. Assertions covered desktop scope, conditional validation, focus, safe states, provider permission denial, post-save controls, and prevention of admin taxonomy requests.
Runtime inventory confirmed the implemented getProviderProperty and saveProviderPropertyStep routes used by the wizard; no provider taxonomy endpoint was invented or called.
Agent Pack audit reported zero errors with only frontend_043 in progress before closure.

scopeNotes: apps/web/src/features/frontend_foundation/app.tsx was modified only for the directly necessary advanced provider wizard route integration; this is the explicitly documented direct integration exception to the selected task Allowed Roots.

The implementation uses the authenticated provider session, server property version, shared provider property step schemas, and the existing provider ownership API. No Backend runtime, shared contract, OpenAPI, Postman, dependency, or database file was changed for this task.

The current runtime exposes no provider-readable property-type, feature, or service catalog. The UI therefore presents explicit unavailable-catalog states and accepts only contract-shaped reference IDs; admin-only taxonomy routes are not called.
The approved Provider Dashboard device scope is desktop only. The executable Playwright matrix covered desktop Arabic RTL, English LTR, and Simplified Chinese LTR.

The in-app browser connector could not initialize because its sandbox metadata lacked sandboxPolicy; repository Playwright supplied the executable browser, visual snapshot, focus, locale, and permission evidence.
knownGaps: The current provider contracts do not expose catalog labels for property types, features, or services. These references remain explicit technical inputs with unavailable-catalog guidance rather than fabricated labels or unsupported API calls.

A provider-specific axe or generic accessibility matrix is not defined for this task; the targeted browser suite covered accessible labels, keyboard focus, direction, safe states, and visual snapshots.
The features/services Continue control remains on the current step because the next provider property contact/media step belongs to frontend_044.
No full-platform completion claim is made.
